name: claude-code-mods
description: Mods and tools for Claude Code: a usage meter, a working critter, and shipkit, a per-project workflow toolkit.

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Session (5h) and weekly usage bars above the prompt, with a /limits pane for pace and reset details.

plugins.name: working-critter
plugins.description: A tiny pixel critter runs at the top-right corner while Claude is working.

plugins.name: shipkit
plugins.description: Forge a project's own /<prefix>:* workflow commands (PRD → issue → PR → checks → pre-merge review → ship, test playbooks, guided tours) from shared templates and a scanned project profile; committed or hidden; re-sync any time.
